class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right

def transformTree(root):
    def reverse_inorder(node):
        nonlocal total
        if node is None:
            return
        reverse_inorder(node.right)
        temp = node.val
        node.val += total
        total += temp
        reverse_inorder(node.left)

    total = 0
    reverse_inorder(root)
    return root
